processing: Selected US/Canada admin1 and North America admin0 map units; removed unused attributes; rounded coordinates to four decimals without line simplification; merged Antigua/Barbuda polygons into one AG click target.
limits: Generalized modern administrative navigation shapes, not Indigenous homelands, treaty boundaries or a statement about recognition/sovereignty.
Natural Earth defaults to de facto administrative boundary depiction; no legal boundary precision is claimed.
Small Caribbean islands need accessible list or enlarged click targets; outlines alone may be too small at a continent scale.
Alaska crosses the antimeridian; use dateline-aware projection or normalize its positive longitudes for a North America view.
Hawaii is included as a US state and may need an inset.
Political types and labels are copied from a Natural Earth snapshot rather than freshly adjudicated current legal status.

lakeLayer.title: Natural Earth 1:50m lakes
lakeLayer.licenseVerification: Primary Natural Earth terms were inspected during original boundary asset preparation; same dataset provider and pinned repository.
lakeLayer.processing: Selected features whose bounding boxes intersect longitude -170 to -20 and latitude 7 to 85; retained lake names and feature class; coordinates rounded to four decimals. No additional simplification.
limits: Generalized cartographic lake-water polygons for a visual overlay, not navigable shorelines or legal water boundaries.
Large administrative polygons can include lake water; draw lake fill above land with pointer-events:none, so water appears while state/province selection remains accessible.
Overlay supplies freshwater shore context only; it does not establish Indigenous territories.

displayNote: Administrative polygons include some lake waters. A separately sourced lake-water overlay restores visible shorelines, including all five Great Lakes. Generalized navigation map, not survey accuracy.
